hooks.name: item_toss
hooks.doc: `ItemTossEvent`: `player` tosses `count` of `item` (`Player.drop`: the drop key, a menu's throw, what no longer fits in the inventory), not what scatters when they die. Set `canceled` and no item entity is made; the items are already out of the inventory and are lost, as in NeoForge. A canceled toss awards no drop statistic, as vanilla awards one only when an item entity came of it. Server-side. Diverges from upstream: replaces the listen-only `item_dropped`, which fired for the drop key and menu throws only.
